key_features: Includes 2x 1U Vented Shelves with Rear Support – Comes with 2× vented 1U shelves (14" depth), each equipped with rear support brackets for enhanced stability and load distribution—ideal for mounting heavier devices like modems, DVRs, or UPS units.
Complete Hardware Kit Included – Package includes 30× 10-32 mounting screws and 8× M5 wood screws for wall mounting—everything you need for quick, secure installation right out of the box.

150 lbs Load Capacity – Built from reinforced cold-rolled steel with a durable black powder-coated finish, this rack supports up to 150 lbs of equipment, exceeding the weight capacity of most competitors in its class.

Universal 19-Inch Compatibility – Designed to fit all standard 19-inch rack-mountable devices. The 20U height accommodates network switches, patch panels, AV gear, and other equipment in both home and professional setups.

Wall-Mount or Floor-Standing Design – Flexible mounting options allow for wall installation or free-standing use. Ideal for network closets, server rooms, home labs, or any environment with space constraints.
